page.overview:
What is Adventure Animatronics?

The adventure animatronics are the main characters of FNaF World, being smaller, childish and colorful versions of the animatronics of the original saga.

The Adventure Animatronics look like smaller, repaired, cute, and childish versions of animatronics that appeared from the four core series games. Some like Withered Chica, Springtrap, Foxy, etc. seem to be more repaired and in better condition, without neglecting some "withered" characteristics in the respective characters.

The player can select two teams of four animatronics each (eight in total), which can be chosen while out of combat, as well as being able to level up as they gain experience after each combat.

Each animatronic has three different attacks with different effects depending on the color with which they are marked. For example, pink attacks heal, red attacks deal damage to all enemies, yellow attacks deal damage to a single enemy, black attacks insta-kill enemies. But each member of the team will have to wait for their turn to attack, and these can vary. Each Adventure has its own combination of attacks and some share the same.
